scope: For two subspaces of a finite-dimensional real or complex positive-definite inner-product space, simultaneous orthogonal complementation preserves the principal-angle lists after adding zero entries to match lengths. The singular values of the difference of their orthogonal projectors are the duplicated sines of those angles together with abs(dim X-dim Y) additional ones, with zero padding on either side as needed.
boundary: Theorem 2.7 equation (2.3) and Theorem 2.9 do not assume equal subspace dimensions. Principal-angle lists have min(dim X,dim Y) entries; they need not retain length after complementation. Equal ranks remove the rank-difference extra ones, not the doubled ones from right angles. Empty-angle maximum needs a separate convention. No indefinite metric, oblique projector or unrestricted infinite-dimensional conclusion.
